follow_ups.reason: Spec-interpretation points: (1) question text and refusal detail pass through derive.redact() and are cut to 300 characters, an addition the spec does not state; (2) lastTurn carries an extra 'mid' key so a streamed reply's text survives a text-less final line; (3) T-16 pinned as PARSER_VERSION > 7 plus a parser-7 cache test, not == 8, so a later bump does not break it; (4) cap keeps the question first then the newest refusals (spec silent on which five); (5) per-session 'more' is folded into the panel's '+N more waiting' line, counted only when that session has a listed item; (6) an item with an unreadable 'at' is not listed and counts as bound-suppressed; (7) the summary tile sits in the Overview tile strip; D4 rows render repo text via md(); (8) clockState includes the listed-item set so the age bound and idleness redraw on the minute tick.
Follow-up PBI (spec row 3): add 'waiting' to the session shape's optional block in local/records.shapes.json.
